subject: Science
stem: Light travels in a straight line, which is why an opaque object blocks light and creates a dark area behind it. This dark area is called a:
explanation: Shadows form because light travels in straight lines (rectilinear propagation) and cannot bend around an opaque object, leaving a dark region where light is blocked.

subject: Science
stem: A ray of light entering a glass prism bends towards the normal on entering (going from a rarer to a denser medium) and bends away from the normal on exiting (going from denser to rarer). This bending of light at the boundary between two media is called:
explanation: Refraction occurs because light changes speed when passing between media of different optical densities, bending toward the normal when entering a denser medium and away from it when exiting.
